labels.justification: The clause grants Data Principals the right to request access to their personal data, aligning with DPDP_ACT-0046.
The clause provides a method for Data Principals to exercise their rights, aligning with DPDP_ACT-0046.
The clause allows Data Principals to control and delete their data, aligning with DPDP_ACT-0046.
The clause does not meaningfully address any listed requirement.
